faq.q: Which yacht is best for recovery after Ironman Marbella?

We offer flexible cancellation up to 48 hours before departure for a full refund. For last-minute changes, contact us via WhatsApp—we do our best to accommodate.

data.body_html:
Crossing the finish line of Ironman Marbella 2033 is a monumental achievement—3.8 km swim, 180 km bike, and a full marathon. After 10+ hours of exertion, your body needs active recovery, not a hotel bed. A post-race yacht charter from Puerto Banús offers the perfect blend of gentle swimming, stretching on deck, and soaking up the Mediterranean sun. Our fleet departs just minutes from the finish line, with prices starting at €749 for two hours including skipper, drinks, and VAT. Here’s how to plan your ultimate recovery day.

Why Choose a Yacht for Ironman Recovery?

Active recovery—low-intensity movement—reduces muscle stiffness faster than complete rest. On a yacht, you can float in 20°C seawater (ideal for reducing inflammation), perform light yoga on a shaded deck, and hydrate with included water, soft drinks, or electrolyte-rich cava. The gentle rocking of the boat also promotes relaxation and mental reset. Plus, you avoid crowded beaches and noisy hotels.

Best Boats for Post-Race Recovery

Our fleet at Boat Rental Marbella offers options for small groups and larger teams. For a recovery session with 5-8 athletes, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are ideal—both from Tier A: €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. For groups up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) from Tier B: €4,719 for 4 hours includes a free jet ski for gentle water therapy. All boats include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and a selection of drinks and snacks.

Where to Go: Best Recovery Spots

Departing from Puerto Banús, your skipper can take you to calm coves perfect for post-race floating. Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés offer sheltered waters with minimal swell. Cabopino Beach is a 15-minute cruise east, with sandy shallows ideal for walking and stretching. For a longer trip, Estepona or Sotogrande provide quiet anchorages. Your skipper will adjust the itinerary based on your energy levels.

What’s Included in Every Charter

  • Licensed skipper (handles navigation and safety)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (nuts, olives, crisps)
  • Insurance and safety equipment (life jackets, first aid)
  • Spanish IVA (21%) included in all prices

No hidden fees. Just bring your recovery gear—swimwear, sunscreen, and a towel.

How to Book Your Recovery Charter

All bookings are handled via WhatsApp for speed and flexibility. Simply message us with your preferred date, group size, and duration. For Tier A boats, we recommend 2-4 hours for a gentle recovery session. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80’s 4-hour minimum allows ample time for swimming and sunbathing. Book at least 2-3 months ahead for Ironman week—boats fill fast.

Ready to plan your post-race recovery? Browse all our Marbella yacht charter options.

Tips for Athletes: Maximise Your Recovery

  • Hydrate: Drink water and electrolyte-rich drinks (we provide both).
  • Swim gently: 10-15 minutes of floating reduces muscle soreness.
  • Stretch on deck: Use the shaded cockpit for light yoga or stretching.
  • Avoid alcohol initially: Save the cava for after rehydration.
  • Apply sunscreen: Mediterranean sun is strong even in June.

Frequently Asked Questions

When is Ironman Marbella 2033?

Ironman Marbella 2033 is scheduled for June 2023 (exact date TBC by organisers). The event typically starts early morning with a 3.8 km swim in the Mediterranean, followed by a 180 km bike course and a 42.2 km marathon finish along the Golden Mile.

How far is Puerto Banús from the Ironman finish line?

Puerto Banús is approximately 5 minutes by taxi or a 20-minute walk from the Marbella finish line. All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, making it a convenient post-race recovery destination.

Which yacht is best for recovery after Ironman Marbella?

For a small group of 5-8 athletes, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (€749/2h) offer spacious sunbeds and a shaded cockpit. For larger groups up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) includes a free jet ski for gentle water therapy.

Can I swim off the yacht for recovery?

Absolutely. All charters include stops at calm coves like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, where you can float in 20°C water to reduce muscle soreness. Life jackets and safety equipment are provided.

What drinks and food are included?

Every charter includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. For post-race nutrition, we recommend bringing your own recovery shakes—our team can store them onboard.
